about: Job 2 (Nov 11 2026): the 17 strong Nov 11 mystery-park matches and the 3 old pins, one row each. NOTHING in this file is read by a key builder: it is the checked record of what each park needs. status: joined-live = the live key already joins the Nov 11 record (pin-tested here from the saved outline); wiring-proposal = the override is already in the live overrides and needs only the layer wired (separate proposal commit); staged = a ready-to-apply entry, kept OUT of the live key until the listed saved copy exists and/or the owner says YES; held = an owner hold that this job does not lift; not-joined = checked and left off, with the reason. Entries for data/us-key/overrides.json are written in the repo's own held form (join_held / alias_held, which no builder reads); to apply one, move its ids / names to join / alias (+ alias_ok_names) and add decided_by. data/us-key/overrides.json is already over 1 MB, so this job did not edit it. Pins: the POTA pins are copied here only to test them; no pin is changed anywhere.
pin_test: offline, this job: even-odd point in polygon over every ring; distance = pin to the nearest edge, local metres. World-bounds shards are the coarse saved copies (about 50 points a ring, 4 decimals), so their distances can differ from the full layer by a few hundred metres.

entry.design: One POTA pin (Oak Ridge, TN) is in all three state files. (1) TN: overrides "US-4376" join of the Oak Ridge unit by id (sgakd1232 once the NPS admin boundary hand file for TN is wired the same way as CA / TX; or the PAD-US Proclamation id) with fp [name, acres]: 4.4 km, inside the 0.6 deg join box and under the 5 km new-join check. (2) NM and WA: an overrides join can never reach them, because every join path tests the record against the ONE pin (0.6 deg box) and the G-1 far-piece path needs a join at the pin in that same state file. If the NPS record is ONE multipart feature for all three units (as RORI is: 3 parts in one record), the TN join draws all three units and NM / WA get "joined_in": TN, with no rules change. If the units are separate records (PAD-US is per site), a no-state / park-code join needs a kpc_us_key.py change = US rules hash moves: not done.
